comparison.objective: Select and fit a wrench, loosen a captive latch nut, and open the released arm.
comparison.physical_skill: Close-tolerance wrench fitting, torque application, damage avoidance, and articulated release.
comparison.success_condition: Release the captive clamp without rounding the nut, open the arm, and demonstrate a 20-second hands-free hold; the preserved rubric does not independently score wrench return.
comparison.reason: This is the nearest tool-mediated fastener task, but it tests rotary loosening and latch release rather than axial mandrel alignment, hammer impact, notch fracture, and loose-part recovery.
